title: Lightsaber Spears
description: Turn your Spears into lightsabers! Sounds included.
body:
All rights go to lucas film and disney. I do not own anything used for this texture pack
Ever wanted lightsabers in minecraft? Well here i have made some and they even have proper sounds! 

Wood-Darksaber

Copper-Doubled blade white

Stone-Double blade green

Iron- Double blade purple

Gold-Double blade yellow

Diamond-Double blade Blue

Netherite-Double blade red

If there is any issue, pls share!
